description: Gives average annual daily flow (AADF) at one DfT count point: the average number of vehicles passing per day over a year, both directions together, split into cars and taxis, vans, HGVs, buses, motorbikes and pedal cycles, newest year first. Answers "how many cars pass this site a day" and "is traffic on this road rising" for shop, billboard, EV charger or planning work. Some years are estimated by DfT rather than counted, and each row says which; it does not cover live traffic or congestion. (cost: 1 credit)

count_point_id.description: integer, required, DfT count point id (from traffic_count_points_on_road or traffic_count_points_in_council)

year.description: integer, optional, a single year such as 2024; default is the most recent years

years.description: integer, optional, how many recent years to return when year is not given, 1-30, default 10

name: road_traffic_flow_at_point
